name: sve-ui
description: Styled, accessible Svelte 5 components built on Bits UI. No Tailwind, no config — install, import, and theme with CSS variables. Light and dark out of the box.
author: Rodrigo Abregu <me@rodriab.io> (https://rodriab.io/)
//sideEffects: Everything here is side-effect-free EXCEPT the stylesheet. NOT `false`: ./theme.css is an exported subpath that consumers import for its effect alone, and a blanket false lets bundlers drop that import, taking every --sve-* token with it.
//files: `skills` ships on purpose: the agent skill teaches a CONSUMER's agent the real API, so it is useless if it only exists in this repo. Guarded by scripts/check-package-files.mjs, which inspects the actual tarball.

scripts.package: svelte-kit sync && svelte-package && node scripts/check-dts.mjs && node scripts/check-treeshake.mjs && node scripts/check-package-files.mjs && publint
